errors.evidence: The slice for "Електрическа енергия" (Electrical energy) is light blue/cyan, not dark blue (тъмносиньо). The dark blue slice represents "Твърди горива" (Solid fuels).
The percentage labels for each slice are positioned outside the pie chart, with lines pointing to the corresponding sectors, not inside them.

errors.text_span: секторите са подредени по низходящ размер от най-големия към най-малкия
errors.evidence: The pie chart sectors are not arranged in descending order of size. When viewed clockwise from the top, the sector sizes are 5.1%, 69.8%, 22.3%, 1.2%, and 1.6%, which is not a sorted sequence.
The slice representing "Електрическа енергия" (Electrical energy) is located in the top-left quadrant of the chart, not the top-right.

errors.text_span: и „Възобновяеми и биогорива“ в горния десен квадрант
